## 5. One Non-Obvious Thing

**WOLF is being held back by its winners, not its losers.**

The MANUAL HALT exists because concentration limits are breached — but the breach is being driven primarily by positions that are *up* (NVDA +7.86% unrealized, MDT +1.95%). The mandate's 8% single-name cap was designed to protect against blowups, yet today it's blocking new entries on a day the portfolio gained +$349. The irony: the rebalance that fires tomorrow to bring PLTR and MDT under 8% will likely realize gains on those positions and reset WOLF's paper-trading P&L baseline — making the Day-60 reassess on 2026-06-05 harder to pass on consecutive-profitable-weeks criteria. The compliance mechanism and the graduation mechanism are pulling in opposite directions. Worth flagging before 2026-06-05.
